base_member_text: [L80-L87, L104] (HIGH/empty-input handling) An empty or unreadable non-stationary wind file yields s%windlen=0 and is then indexed as s%windinpt(0) in the duration check.
audit_member_text: [L80-L104] (HIGH/empty-input bounds) An empty wind file produces windlen=0 and then indexes windinpt(0) in the duration check.

base_member_text: [L92-L104] (MED/input contract validation) Non-stationary wind timestamps are not checked for strict monotonicity before later time interpolation.

audit_member_text: [L51-L59] (MED/MPI initialization contract) Non-master ranks return before allocating or initializing any wind fields, and this routine contains no distribution step.
[L56-L67,L87-L91] (LOW/allocation lifetime) All wind arrays are allocated unconditionally with no associated/allocated checks, requiring readwind to be called exactly once.
[L80-L97] (MED/input validation) The record-count pass treats any nonzero IOSTAT as end-of-file, so a malformed record silently truncates the series rather than being reported.
